verdict.rationale: Zapier provides thousands of prebuilt, vendor-maintained app integrations (9,000+ apps cited repeatedly) accessible via Visual Builder, MCP, and API, corroborated by independent community reports confirming the breadth (~1,000+) and ease of use of its integration catalog compared to competitors. Missing for 10: no independent third-party audit of the full current app count or comprehensive vendor-maintenance quality across all 9,000+ integrations.
